entry.title: Overleaf to Google Docs™: Chapters, .bib and Figures

link.title: Overleaf to Google Docs™: Chapters, .bib and Figures

entry.summary: Overleaf cannot export to Google Docs™, so to move an Overleaf project into Docs you download its source as a .zip and import the .tex from it. LaTeXFlow Import writes the headings, lists, tables and equations into the document; the .bib file and the figures from the same .zip go in with two short steps of their own. A single short .tex file is covered in You Received a .tex File, part by part...

entry.title: How to Copy Math From ChatGPT to Google Docs™

link.title: How to Copy Math From ChatGPT to Google Docs™

entry.summary: To copy math from ChatGPT to Google Docs™, copy the answer with its copy button and paste it. Docs may turn some of it into equations by itself, and whatever it leaves as LaTeX text, the free LaTeXFlow add-on converts in one scan. Use that button rather than selecting the rendered maths with the mouse: a selection of rendered maths does not carry the LaTeX, and nothing can rebuild it afterwards...
